selection_law: No person, movement, company, fund, institution, race, ideology, or patriotic phrase is selected because it is disliked, famous, expected to be incriminating, or already belongs to the preferred narrative. Each lane declares a source universe and processes supportive, contradictory, ordinary, failed, and null records under the same predicates.
